scope_interpretation.disposition: Conditional reference to SNL215 shaft assembly; kept as ReferencedSurveyIds on container. No survey merge or duplicate physical shaft.
scope_interpretation.reason: Full transmission list omits the two levers and keys separately; component-specific SNL215 lists M305 with M303, M304 and two No.C keys.

limits: No.C key dimensions remain unverified: radius12.7 and width6.35mm are explicit reconstruction estimates, not a recovered standard.
Shaft center, diameters and axial stations use a straightened interpretation of a slightly slanted SNL23 drawing; journal and case dimensions are inferred.
Opposed blind bearings, shaft shoulders, integral rounded top-lever finger and cross-socket in M302 are inferred constructions. Motion, torque capacity and retention under load are unqualified.
Each M306 receives one MX11 bolt and one MX12 stud. This allocation and transverse spacing are inferred; both source attachment quantities are represented.

MX12 diameter12.7, length98.425, US thread20.6375 and SAE thread22.225mm are printed. MX11 underhead length110mm, head dimensions, engagement and clearances are estimates. Threads use nominal envelopes.
M263 receives local lands and bored attachment seats; the existing rear-wall contour discrepancy remains unresolved. M302 changes only its provisional linkage-end hole.
Lower lever orientation and eye geometry remain provisional until the long reverse linkage is installed.
This is a standard forward assembly candidate; full tank integration, pump/support, brakes, lubrication and other interior systems remain pending.
